lines.text: Six men with weapons of slaughter come from the Upper Gate, and they stand beside the bronze altar.
A man clothed in linen carries a writing kit, and God's glory moves from above the cherubim to the temple threshold.
The LORD sends the man in linen through Jerusalem to mark the foreheads of men groaning over the abominations.
God orders the six men to spare no one and to begin at His sanctuary with the priests.
Ezekiel falls facedown and asks if God will destroy the remnant, and God says the people claim the LORD has cleansed the land.
